failures.detail: Contract §4/K8 gates byte-for-byte passing of non-UTF-8 argv elements on Unix. Observed in the harness record: elements 0-6 differ (e.g. expected fffe2d78, observed efbfbdefbfbd2d78; 61 ff 62 style bytes become U+FFFD); element 7 (valid UTF-8) matches. All other assertions in the check pass (exit 0, stderr empty, meta valid, no stray writes). The harness precondition that the args are not valid UTF-8 passed, and conformance.py (sha256 f2ccd7e7...) marks the check gating, consistent with K8, so this is not a harness defect. Cause per prototypes/ts/REPORT.md: Bun decodes argv to JS strings before user code runs. It is a stack limitation, but K8 says a stack that cannot pass records the limitation and still fails the check; the FFI route (_NSGetArgv, /proc/self/cmdline) is explicitly ruled as routing around, so it is not conformance. Deterministic: failed 3 of 3 isolated reruns with --only (exit 1 each) in addition to the full run. I verified the failure output myself but did not independently reproduce the Bun-decoding cause beyond the REPORT.
